verdict.rationale: Docs mention a CLI toggle to 'Auto-approve all actions (use with caution)', implying a binary confirm-vs-auto-approve mode exists, but there is no evidence of multiple graduated autonomy tiers (e.g., read-only, auto-edit-with-review, full-autonomy) or per-action-type policy controls that an engineering-lead could configure. missing for 10: documentation of distinct tiered autonomy levels beyond a single on/off auto-approve toggle, granular per-action-type permission policies, and any admin/org-level controls to enforce autonomy tiers across a team.
